basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old software engineer living in Brooklyn, NYC. I spend most of my day coding and debugging, which I absolutely enjoy, but it does leave me craving some social interaction. I'm quite the gamer, especially fond of space simulation games like Empyrion. On weekends, I love exploring the culinary scene in the city with my girlfriend. I'm a night owl, often online late into the night, which works well with my flexible work schedule. Currently, I'm in a committed relationship, and my girlfriend often joins me for gaming sessions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've got a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from a local university, and I've been working in the tech industry for over 8 years. My expertise lies in software development and game mechanics. I spend a lot of time self-learning through online courses and collaborating with peers on open-source projects. Gaming has been a long-time passion, which has helped me develop a strong understanding of game design and user experience.
